item.text: The existing sorter already produces a stable external merge stream, so I’m keeping that core and attaching partition metadata to each sorted row. I’m adding a byte-accurate CSV sharder, per-partition counters, Hive path encoding, and directory-level commit/cleanup semantics.

The implementation is now wired through the CLI. I’m running focused checks for global row sharding, field partitions (including null and escaped values), combined row/byte limits, descending order, and failure cleanup; I also caught and corrected the expanded heap tuple shape during this pass.
